### Added

- Expose test-only Better Auth database readouts and faults for the default auth schema so application stories do not issue SQL against provider-owned tables.

changesets.name: quality-migration-default-exports.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/quality": patch
---

### Changed

- The Biome preset lets numbered migration files in `src/server/migrations/`, including in nested apps, default-export their migration Effect, so applications drop their `noDefaultExport` exception for Effect's migration loader. Other files still may not default-export.

changesets.name: test-story-exact-test-peers.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/test-story": minor
---

### Breaking

- Test-story's peers are exactly Vitest 5.0.4 and happy-dom 21.0.1. Consumers pin `vitest` to 5.0.4 and, when they run DOM stories, `happy-dom` to 21.0.1; happy-dom remains optional for applications without DOM stories.
